text: The future of artificial intelligence promises to reshape our world in extraordinary ways. Researchers predict we may achieve general AI, or AGI, within the next few decades—machines that can think and learn like humans across any task. This breakthrough could bring immense benefits: accelerating medical discoveries, personalizing education, and solving complex climate problems. However, experts also warn of serious risks, such as job displacement, privacy erosion, and the challenge of keeping advanced systems under human control. While some optimists suggest AGI by 2050, others say we need much more time to build safe systems. Ultimately, the future depends on careful planning and ethical guidelines to ensure this powerful technology serves humanity responsibly.
